description.en: W-AE (operator 2026-10-07 'підключай уже'): AX0's counters written to Workers Analytics Engine, dataset dowiz_counters, binding COUNTERS, so a hibernation no longer erases them. Each venue's Durable Object writes ONE data point through its own env: at every flush (/fold/counters?flush=1, the nightly's /api/owner/health?counters=flush) and every 16th stored write, at most 48 NTH-points per object per UTC day (the flush is not capped). A point is a DELTA since the previous accepted point, so SUM(_sample_interval * doubleN) over any span counts each event once. A refused write (no binding, platform error) is logged, counted in health counters.ae.errors, KEPT in memory and carried by the next point; it never fails a request. The card's 'write when an object wakes while the previous window holds unflushed data' cannot exist: the counters are memory-only, so at a wake the previous window is already gone; every-16th-write bounds the loss to < 16 writes' worth per eviction. Budget at 1,000 hubs: 1,000 x (48 + 1) = 49,000 points/day of the Free plan's 100,000. No personal data: venue object name, cause, clock label, counts.
description.uk: Лічильники об'єкта закладу (AX0) пишуться в Workers Analytics Engine (набір dowiz_counters): одна точка на кожен flush і на кожен 16-й запис, не більше 48 на день на заклад; без персональних даних.

producer.what: send: writeDataPoint through env.COUNTERS; an absent binding is Err, never a panic
counters_route: a flush writes the point first
ae_point: venue = ctx.id.name; refusal logged + kept

consumer.what: AE_SQL: the day's sums, weighted by _sample_interval
aeSums: POST to the SQL API
countersMeasure: AE first, health windows as the labelled fallback

sources.says: Workers Free: 100,000 data points written/day, 10,000 read queries/day; Paid: 10M / 1M per month; not billed yet
20 blobs, 20 doubles, 1 index (<= 96 bytes) per writeDataPoint; blobs <= 16 KB per point; 250 points per invocation; 3 months retention
[[analytics_engine_datasets]] binding/dataset; SQL endpoint; token permission Account Analytics Read
POST, Authorization: Bearer, columns dataset/timestamp/_sample_interval/index1/blob1..20/double1..20, FORMAT JSON
env contains the environment bindings available to this Durable Object
name is available on ctx.id inside the Durable Object when the caller uses idFromName()

point.description: One data point as written (index1, blob1..3, double1..15).

doubles.description: double1..double15 = since_total, since_none, wakes_total, wakes_writing, reads, writes, proj_rows, cold_folds, cold_fold_us, cold_fold_p50_us, cat_writes, cat_decode_us, cat_decoded_bytes, journal_us, journal_bytes

request.auth: Bearer token with Account Analytics Read
